notes: TBox subject insert. 'A Dorran polygon' in q1 is a generic member (a placeholder given as a Dorran polygon). Side count and angle sum of a convex hexagon are firm functional values. Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30.

fol.notes: The polygon d stands for 'a Dorran polygon' in each prompt. The hexagon facts (six sides, angle sum 720) and the two geometry rules are firm; the edit is the class rule.

hexagon_sides.says: A convex hexagon has six sides.

hexagon_angle_sum.says: The interior angles of every convex hexagon add up to 720 degrees.

angle_sum_def.says: The angle sum of a six-sided polygon is the sum of its six interior angles.
angle_sum_def.z3: All(s, [d], Implies(number_of_sides(s) == 6, angle_sum(s) == angle(s, 1) + angle(s, 2) + angle(s, 3) + angle(s, 4) + angle(s, 5) + angle(s, 6)))

diagonals_rule.says: A polygon with n sides has n(n − 3)/2 diagonals.

five_angles.says: Five of the interior angles of a Dorran polygon measure 120 degrees each.
